notes: All values are world metres. Gate scans use 0.02 m conservative sample intervals at floor+0.2, +1.2 and +1.8 m, through 4 m wall depth. Only moving door leaves and their explicit blocker are excluded to measure an unlocked aperture; no transforms or collider states are changed.

The visible aperture also tests original shell and fixed gate-frame triangles, plus the leaf triangles translated by the configured fully-open slide. Both collision and mesh tests must clear. The wider collision opening defines the conservative approach reservation.

NavMesh queries describe loaded Edit-mode data, not runtime gate carving or an AI/Play-mode test. A 0.3 m sample tolerance is used. Body clearance uses a radius 0.4 m, height 1.8 m capsule with 0.05 m floor clearance. Ring static obstructions and movable NavMeshAgent overlaps are counted separately.

The visual floor top and ceiling underside come from original tile renderer bounds. Floor support is tested separately: these room tiles are model instances without the kit prefab's BoxCollider. The existing ground collider supplies movement support.

Keep-outs are design reservations: 2 m spawn/NPC discs, opening plus 1 m each side and 4 m inside each gate, terminal access box, 4-8 m central annulus. Navigation paths need a 1.5 m half-width reservation; none authorizes moving existing objects.
